title: Two Mass Shootings Leave at Least 27 Dead Across South Africa
detail: Two separate mass shootings struck South Africa on 27 September 2026, killing at least 27 people in total. The incidents highlight the country's persistent gang violence crisis and deepening public security emergency, with communities in affected areas demanding urgent government action.

media.caption: Scene from one of two mass shootings in South Africa leaving at least 27 dead
